root_cause.text: The functions `dc_dmub_srv_log_diagnostic_data()` and `dc_dmub_srv_enable_dpia_trace()` attempt to log an error using `DC_LOG_ERROR()` when `dc_dmub_srv` is NULL, which internally dereferences `dc_dmub_srv->ctx` and causes a NULL pointer dereference.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff splits the combined check `if (!dc_dmub_srv || !dc_dmub_srv->dmub)` into two separate checks, returning immediately if `dc_dmub_srv` is NULL, because as the commit message explains, "DC_LOG_ERROR() uses dc_dmub_srv->ctx internally. So if dc_dmub_srv is NULL, the logging itself can dereference a NULL pointer and cause a crash."
